jobs.title: Mobile Patrol Officer Mon-Wed, 9AM–1PM; Thurs-Fri, 4PM–8PM
jobs.description_text:
Job Overview

The Security Officer for ParkX Management ensures that the facility is run smoothly, safely, cleanly, and is a good experience for residents, tenants, and guests.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Complete hourly patrol route of the property using the security system
  • Access control for guests, tenants and vendors
  • Ensure no property is being damaged
  • Conduct of routine foot patrols in and around building.
  • Perform other duties as assigned 
  • Observation and reporting of safety
  • Issue Banning notices to rule violators      
  • Maintain file for Ban Notices and notify management when necessary
  • Maintain the appearance of the two plaza kiosks 
  • Enforce the “no dogs on the plaza” policy
  • Keep updated information (e.g., Kiss N Ride, Contact Phone #’s, Rules of Conduct) and communicate to guests as needed
  • Report any unknown work that is occurring at the property to management
  • If anyone parks illegally on the plaza, notify Park X, Commercial property management, and Residential property management immediately 
  • Communicate to guests that we must keep the fire access areas accessible for fire trucks and ambulances
  • Close loading dock doors as needed
  • Report any concerns to management

Qualifications

  • High School D

jobs.title: Part-Time Office Cleaner (Monday - Friday, 6PM-10PM)
jobs.description_text:
Job Overview

The ParkX Cleaner is responsible for maintaining cleanliness in the common areas at assigned sites. Duties include general upkeep such as pressure washing, window cleaning, trash removal, and routine cleaning tasks. Porter also support event setup and cleanup when necessary and respond to cleanliness concerns as they arise. The position requires reliability, attention to detail, and the ability to work professionally and courteously with property staff, tenants, and visitors. 

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensures all common areas, including sidewalks, lobbies, restrooms, and public spaces are kept clean and presentable.
  • Completes daily cleaning and janitorial tasks as assigned by the Senior Operations Manager, Janitorial.
  • Pressure washes areas as assigned by management.
  • Reports to assigned location in the approved ParkX Porter uniform.
  • Reports to assigned location before the start of the work shift.
  • Ensures compliance with all safety regulations and cleaning standards.
  • Exhibits a professional and courteous demeanor with all site visitors.
  • Acknowledges, greets, and interacts professionally with property staff and guests, using appropriate protocols.
  • Assists management teams with special cleaning or maintenance requests as needed.
  • Always maintains a neat and orderly janitorial closet and storage areas, free of debris and haza

Comstock is excited to welcome a passionate Senior Leasing Consultant to our team! As a leading developer of high-quality, sustainable, mixed-use, and transit-oriented communities, we’re looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, people-focused environment. If you love connecting with people, creating memorable experiences, and guiding residents through the leasing journey from “hello” to “welcome home,” this opportunity was made for you. Join us and help bring our beautiful community to life.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide warm and engaging customer service, showcasing the benefits of our community.
  • Oversee the entire leasing process, from lead generation to tenant occupancy, ensuring a smooth experience for all.
  • Prepare leasing paperwork and maintain accurate weekly/monthly reports.
  • Creatively market the community online, through social media, and within the local neighborhood.
  • Coordinate promotions to increase traffic and maintain high occupancy rates.
  • Manage and innovate our social media presence to engage current and prospective tenants.
  • Perform administrative duties to support the leasing process and other assigned tasks.

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma; Bachelor’s degree preferred, especially in business or related fields.
  • Minimum of 2 years of leasi

jobs.title: Senior Maintenance Technician ($1500 Sign on Bonus)
jobs.description_text:
Job Overview

Join our dedicated maintenance team at a luxury apartment community, where exceptional service and high-quality living standards are top priorities. We are seeking a skilled Senior Maintenance Technician with experience in HVAC, plumbing, electrical, appliance repair, and general carpentry. This role requires a proactive problem-solver who can perform preventative maintenance and respond to work orders efficiently and professionally. A strong commitment to customer service, clear communication, and a polished, resident-first attitude are essential in maintaining our five-star living environment. #weshowup

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide Class “A” customer service – building a good rapport with residents and going above and beyond whenever possible
  • Perform repairs, maintenance, and cleaning of property both interior and exterior
  • Protect and assist in improving the value of the client’s assets
  • Perform PM on unit based and building level equipment
  • Perform emergency on-call service in a rotation order 
  • Perform electrical, plumbing, carpentry, masonry and painting
  • Repair and treat structures such as showers, sinks, appliances, doors/cabinets, walls and building exteriors
  • Make ready units for new move-ins
  • Complete grounds work such as grounds pick up, sweeping and light landscaping
  • Perform other duties as assigned

jobs.title: Senior Talent Acquisition Manager
jobs.description_text:
Position Description

For more than 40 years, Comstock has been developing, owning, and operating places where people live, work, and play across the Washington, D.C. region. Behind every one of those places is a team, and that team keeps growing across our divisions. We’re looking for a Sr. Talent Acquisition Manager to lead the recruiters who bring those people in. This role is for someone who is a recruiter at heart and a leader by instinct: close enough to the work to fill a critical role yourself, and experienced enough to coach a team, shape priorities, and make the whole function run better as we grow.

Key Responsibilities

 

  • Recruiting Leadership & Team Development: Lead, coach, and develop the recruiting team while managing workloads, priorities, performance, and professional development.

  • Full-Cycle Recruiting & Strategy: Oversee recruiting across ParkX, Residential, and Corporate, balancing high-volume operational hiring with property management, professional, and corporate recruiting needs.

jobs.description_text:
Who we are 

Atoms is building the machines that power the next era of progress.

Over the last decade, software has transformed the digital world. But the physical world, where food is made, minerals are mined, goods are moved, and industries are run, remains far less intelligent, far less efficient, and far more constrained. We’re changing that.

Atoms builds Physical AI— real-world robots for the industries that move civilization forward, starting with food, mining, and transport. Our systems are designed to understand, predict, and control the real world with precision, turning complex physical operations into something more reliable, more scalable, and more productive.

This work requires more than robotics. It requires deep integration across hardware, software, AI, operations, manufacturing, and real estate. We don’t just build machines in a lab. We deploy them into real environments, operate them, learn from them, and improve them until they work at scale.

We are roboticists, engineers, operators, and builders. We believe the next great technology companies will not only transform information, but the physical systems that shape everyday life.

EnergyHub empowers utilities and their customers to create a clean, distributed energy future. Our customers are real utilities managing the real electrical grid supporting the normal lives of millions of real people. Our mission is to keep the grid running reliably while enabling more renewable energy and reducing reliance on fossil fuel.

EnergyHub’s Client Success team launches and operates best-in-class programs for utilities, helping them address grid challenges by engaging customers with connected devices. This is a highly visible, client facing role, ideal for someone who has a passion for working with clients and software products, enjoys solving complex challenges, and is curious about the energy distribution systems that power our daily lives. The successful candidate is a quick learner and self-starter, has the ability to communicate a variety of data driven messages to varying audiences, can build relationships effortlessly, is client-focused, and consistently achieves results.
